subject: Phased pricing & ops onboarding for on‑prem VPC deployment
messages:
From: Tim Carter <tim.carter@medisys.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, procurement@medisys.com
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medisys.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: phased pricing & onboarding for on-prem deployment

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. MediSys is moving forward with an on‑prem VPC deployment for a pilot (initially 6 nodes, target production ramp to 30 nodes over 9 months). Before we lock SOW terms, procurement and our security team want clarity on:

- Whether Redwood can offer a phased platform fee amortization (starter credit + ramped platform fee) so we can start with a smaller budget during pilot.
- A clear support tier breakdown and what’s included during the pilot vs production (SLAs, oncall, escalation path).
- Any upfront discounts for committing to a 12/24 month node/throughput commitment.
- KMS/HSM and audit log access for our compliance team — they may request a temporary review deployment.

Attached is our implementation timeline and NDA for legal. Can you send a short commercial/ops proposal that covers both a 60‑90 day pilot and the production ramp?

Would like to move quickly this month if we can align on commercials.

Thanks,
Tim Carter
VP, IT Infrastructure
MediSys Health

Attachments: MediSys_NDA.pdf, MediSys_Implementation_TL_v2.xlsx

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Tim Carter <tim.carter@medisys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased pricing & onboarding for on-prem deployment

Hi Tim — appreciate the clarity and the timeline. High level response below; I’ve attached a short phased pricing proposal and an onboarding playbook for technical ops. Happy to walk through on a 30‑minute call.

Proposal highlights (pilot -> production):

- Starter credit: waive first 3 months of platform fee (applied as one‑time credit) during a 60‑day pilot.
- Platform fee amortization: option A) amortize platform fee over 24 months (lower monthly platform charge), option B) 12‑month amortization with larger initial platform fee.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 8x5), Enhanced (24x7 email + 4‑hour P1 phone), Enterprise (24x7 phone + named SLAs & periodic on‑site/remote runbooks). Pilot ships with Standard by default; upgradeable to Enhanced for a fixed monthly premium or temporary enterprise band for go‑live.
- Committed node discount: 12‑month node commit -> 15% off platform fee on committed baseline; 24‑month -> 22% (tiered). Additional ramp credits available if commit includes reserved capacity for burst.
- Implementation credit: 1x professional services credit (up to 40 hours) for early adopters who sign within 30 days.

Operational notes:
- We can provide a short read‑only audit instance for your security team to validate logs and KMS behavior prior to full provisioning.
- KMS options: bring‑your‑own KMS (customer KMS with HSM) or Redwood‑managed KMS with key import.

I’ll loop Marissa/Vivek for the commercial term sheet and Laura for compliance artifacts. Proposed next step: 30‑minute telco tomorrow to go through numbers and confirm which amortization path fits your finance plan.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Phased_Pricing_Proposal.pdf, Onprem_onboarding_playbook.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tim Carter <tim.carter@medisys.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased pricing & onboarding for on-prem deployment

Tim — adding the commercial lens. I ran the numbers against the 6→30 node ramp and sketched two options (attached):

Option 1 — Pilot forward (lower near‑term cash out):
- Starter credit: first 3 months platform fee waived (matches Jasmine).
- 12‑month amortization for platform fee; committed baseline (6 nodes) priced with 15% discount.
- If you convert to production (>=18 nodes within 9 months), we apply a one‑time onboarding rebate equal to 10% of first 12 months’ platform fees.

Option 2 — Committed discount (capex‑style):
- 24‑month commit for baseline → 22% discount on baseline platform fee + 1 month free each 12 months (effectively 2 months over 24).
- Implementation credit increases to 60 hours.

Notes:
- We can combine a small upfront implementation credit + a consumption‑linked rebate to reduce perceived cash burden while aligning long‑term economics.
- If procurement prefers a single invoice cadence, we can present a blended amortized monthly fee with a separate line for professional services.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (I’ve created MS-2026-089). Attached: commercial_term_sheet_v1.xlsx with line‑item breakouts.

If this looks reasonable, I’ll draft a short SOW that ties the credits to milestones (pilot completion, security signoff, conversion to production).

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: commercial_term_sheet_v1.xlsx

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medisys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased pricing & onboarding for on-prem deployment

Thanks — a few security items before we can sign off on pilot provisioning:

- We need your most recent SOC 2 attestation and a short summary of the controls around key management and logging.
- For the read‑only audit instance, does Redwood support delivering log exports to our SIEM (splunk ingestion) and can you allow an engineer to run a short evidence collection run?
- KMS: we prefer BYOK to retain key custody. If BYOK isn’t supported for initial pilot, we need a documented mitigation.

If you can attach the SOC 2 PDF and a KMS integration note, we’ll triage internally and propose a date for the security review call.

—Olivia
CISO, MediSys Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medisys.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased pricing & onboarding for on-prem deployment

Hi Olivia — Laura here (Head of Security, Redwood). Thanks for the specifics — attaching the SOC2 attestation and the KMS integration guide. Quick answers inline: 

- SOC 2: attached (SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf). Controls cover encryption in transit and at rest, key lifecycle, and regular penetration testing.
- Log exports: yes — we can stream audit logs to your Splunk instance (S3 staging + Kinesis connector) and provide a short runbook for evidence collection.
- BYOK: fully supported. For the pilot we can provide two options: a) BYOK via your KMS with key import and local HSM, or b) Redwood‑managed KMS with customer key wrapping. Both documented in KMS_Integration_Guide.pdf.

Proposed next step: 45‑minute security review call next week (I’m available Tue/Wed mornings PST). Laura B. (Redwood) will bring the compliance runbook and an engineer to walk the integration steps.

If the commercial terms above (starter credit + amortization) look ok from procurement, Marissa can draft the SOW and we can attach the compliance schedule.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf, KMS_Integration_Guide.pdf
